senses.definition: appearing as such but not necessarily so
examples: for all his apparent wealth, he had no money to pay the rent
the committee investigated some apparent discrepancies
the ostensible truth of their theories

senses.definition: represented or appearing as such; pretended
examples: His ostensible purpose was charity, his real goal popularity
irrigation often produces bumper crops from apparently desert land
the child is seemingly healthy but the doctor is concerned
had been ostensibly frank as to his purpose while really concealing it
on the face of it the problem seems minor
